profile_text.body:
Seagate Technology Holdings plc is a public company headquartered in Singapore and traded under the ticker STX. On its own website, Seagate describes itself as a leader in mass-capacity data storage and says it has delivered more than four billion terabytes of capacity over the past four decades. The company says it makes storage that scales and that it brings trust and integrity to innovations that depend on data.

Seagate states that it is optimizing storage for AI, describing capacity gains intended to support efficient data center architecture and buildout. It also points to five strategic shifts it says can help close the gap between AI's growing data demands and infrastructure readiness, and notes that people and machines will create data in more ways and at a faster pace as AI proliferates.

The record lists no products, lawsuits, or MCP servers for the company. Its profile gives a CIK of 0001137789 and lists it as a for-profit public company.
